import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
               label=gender, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color='skyblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(bmi_counts))
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Stress Level vs Physical Activity
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
           c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Stress vs Physical Activity', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax4.collections[0], ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps by Occupation
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
occupation_steps = df.groupby('Occupation')['Daily Steps'].mean().sort_values()
ax5.barh(range(len(occupation_steps)), occupation_steps.values, color='coral', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_steps)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(occupation_steps.index, fontsize=9)
ax5.set_xlabel('Average Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
ax6.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, 
        color=['lightgreen', 'salmon', 'lightyellow'][:len(disorder_counts)], 
        edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Heart Rate vs Sleep Quality
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
scatter = ax7.scatter(df['Heart Rate'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax7.set_xlabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Heart Rate vs Sleep Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax7)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 8. Sleep Duration by BMI Category
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
bmi_order = ['Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
bmi_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration'].values 
            for bmi in bmi_order if bmi in df['BMI Category'].values]
ax8.boxplot(bmi_data, labels=[b for b in bmi_order if b in df['BMI Category'].values],
           patch_artist=True)
ax8.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Sleep Duration by BMI', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
